name: cx-listing-playbook
description: Finds why a listing won't sell, then judges if each fix worked.
author: ComChatX

comchatx.about: 找出 listing 卖不动的原因，改后判断是否见效。

about.en: Creating a listing in the stores you name, from your product's data.
about.zh: 用你的产品资料在你指定的站点创建 listing。

about.en: How a listing performs and why, and how a change to it is checked before it is sent.
about.zh: 分析 listing 的表现和原因，提交修改前检查。

about.en: One file for each change to a listing: before, after, what was expected and Amazon's receipt.
about.zh: 每次修改 listing 都存一个文件，写明改前改后、预期效果和亚马逊的回执。

about.en: Whether a change worked, did not, or cannot be told yet.
about.zh: 判断一次修改已见效、未见效，还是暂时无法确定。

about.en: How Amazon picks the Featured Offer (Buy Box), why your offer holds it or not, and which causes a change in your store can reach.
about.zh: 分析亚马逊如何分配 Buy Box、你的报价为何拿到或没拿到，以及哪些原因能在店铺里解决。

listing-create.zh: 用你自己的话和产品资料，在你指定的站点创建亚马逊 listing，例如 /listing-create US,DE 新品上架，数据在 /tenant/products/new-router/，FBA 发货。

listing-review.zh: 检查一条亚马逊 listing：表现如何、有什么变化、该改什么。
